title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinion on Further Strengthening the Cultural Development of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Further Strengthening the Cultural Development of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2010] No. 31

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Opinions on Further Strengthening the Cultural Development of People's Courts of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued for your earnest implementation in light of actual work.

July 28, 2010

Opinions on Further Strengthening the Cultural Development of People's Courts

Court culture is the collective term for the common values, modes of conduct, institutional norms, and related material manifestations gradually formed by the People's Courts in the long-term practice of adjudication and management activities. It is an important component of the advanced socialist culture with Chinese characteristics and a vital part of the socialist rule of law culture. To earnestly implement the central government's requirements for strengthening the development of advanced socialist culture, continuously carry out the theme practice activity of "People's Judges for the People," vigorously promote the judicial core values of fairness, integrity, and service to the people, comprehensively enhance the ideological realm, professional ethics, and humanistic literacy of court personnel, strive to create a distinctive cultural atmosphere that advocates learning and positive progress, cultivate and foster a court team that is politically steadfast, professionally competent, wholly devoted to the people, fair and incorruptible, deeply advance the three key tasks, and strive to achieve new developments in the work of the People's Courts, the following opinions are hereby proposed.

1. The Significance, Guiding Ideology, and Basic Principles of Strengthening the Cultural Development of People's Courts

(1) Fully recognize the importance of strengthening the cultural development of People's Courts. Practice has proven that advanced culture possesses unique functions and immense appeal, capable of playing roles in education, edification, guidance, regulation, cohesion, and motivation through subtle influence. The 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China proposed to "adhere to the direction of advanced socialist culture, set off a new upsurge in socialist cultural development, stimulate the cultural creativity of the whole nation, and enhance the country's cultural soft power." To implement the spirit of the 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, in recent years, the People's Courts have made many beneficial explorations in areas such as spiritual culture, institutional culture, behavioral culture, and material culture, playing a positive role in promoting the scientific development of the People's Courts. However, it must also be recognized that there are still problems in the cultural development of People's Courts, such as insufficient attention, unbalanced development, unclear priorities, weak connection with adjudication and enforcement work, and failure to form a long-term mechanism. People's Courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the central government's requirements, further strengthen the cultural development of People's Courts, take effective measures to solve existing problems, fully utilize the power of advanced culture to strengthen value concepts, lay a solid ideological foundation, stimulate team vitality, publicize court work, and establish the court's image.

(2) The guiding ideology for the cultural development of People's Courts. Hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics, take Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents" as guidance, deeply implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, adhere to the socialist core value system, firmly establish the socialist rule of law concept, uphold the guiding ideology of "Three Supremes" and the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," follow the characteristics of judicial work and the laws of cultural construction, deeply explore and continuously enrich the cultural connotation of court work, vigorously strengthen the construction of spiritual culture, institutional culture, behavioral culture, and material culture of the People's Courts, and provide spiritual motivation, intellectual support, and cultural guarantee for the scientific development of the People's Courts.

(3) The basic principles for the cultural development of People's Courts. Adhere to a people-oriented approach, respect the principal status of court personnel, guide people with scientific theory, edify people with advanced culture, inspire people with noble spirit, and promote the comprehensive development of court personnel; adhere to full participation, strengthen the sense of ownership among court personnel, mobilize and organize the majority of court personnel to actively contribute their wisdom and talents to the cultural construction of the court; adhere to integrating with reality, follow the requirements of being close to adjudication, close to judges, and close to the grassroots, implement cultural construction in all aspects of court work, and strive for practical results; adhere to inheritance and innovation, pay attention to carrying forward the excellent traditional Chinese culture, learn from advanced cultures of other industries, absorb beneficial achievements of foreign rule of law culture, resolutely resist the negative influence of decadent culture, and continuously explore new content and new carriers for court cultural construction with innovative ideas and methods.

2. Vigorously Promote the Judicial Core Values of Fairness, Integrity, and Service to the People

The judicial core values of fairness, integrity, and service to the people are the concentrated embodiment of the socialist core value system in the judicial field, the essential connotation of the spiritual culture of the People's Courts, and the essence and soul of court culture. The research, education, and practice of the judicial core values shall be regarded as the primary task of the cultural development of People's Courts, prominently grasped and ensured to be integrated into thoughts and reflected in behavior.

(1) Strengthen theoretical research. Guided by the Marxist worldview and methodology, incorporate the judicial core values into the research scope of the socialist core value system and the judicial value system. Adopt various forms such as seminars to deeply explore and explain the scientific connotation, significance, and practical requirements of the judicial core values, providing theoretical support for publicity, education, and implementation.

(2) Carry out education and training. Extensively conduct education activities on judicial core values among all court personnel, guiding them to firmly establish correct views on power, money, and status. Incorporate the judicial core values into the court personnel training content system, ensuring they enter textbooks, classrooms, and minds. Focus on the training of main leading cadres, newly appointed leading cadres, and front-line court personnel.

(3) Carry out characteristic practical activities. Closely integrate the cultivation of judicial core values with adjudication and enforcement, court reform, and team building, timely organize thematic practice activities, and guide the majority of court personnel to achieve the unity of learning and using, knowledge and action. Use forms popular with the majority of court personnel, such as speech contests, essay solicitation activities, calligraphy, painting and photography exhibitions, singing competitions, and theatrical performances, to vigorously promote the judicial core values, effectively enhance their appeal, and ensure they are deeply rooted in people's hearts.

(4) Establish the court spirit. Closely focus on the judicial core values, combine the court's fine traditions, local cultural characteristics, court work, and team reality, summarize and refine the court spirit, and actively publicize and display the spiritual and cultural outlook of the court.

(5) Carry out judge oath-taking activities. According to the judicial core values, establish and promote the implementation of the judge oath-taking system. Judges shall, by publicly declaring the oath, solemnly promise loyalty to the Party and the state, love for the people, respect for the law, and adherence to their duties.

(6) Strengthen external publicity. Fully utilize modern mass media and communication methods to widely publicize the judicial core values to the whole society, continuously expand social influence. Actively publicize externally various measures and important achievements of the People's Courts in practicing the judicial core values, and strive to create a favorable social public opinion environment.

3. Strengthen Judicial Professional Cultivation and Establish a Good Professional Image

Good judicial professional cultivation and professional image are concrete manifestations of the judicial core values and the main goal of the behavioral culture construction of the People's Courts. Focus on the construction of judicial professional ethics and behavioral norms, vigorously strengthen the construction of behavioral culture, and cultivate and establish a professional image of judicial fairness, integrity and honesty, wholehearted service to the people, and standardized civility.

(1) Strengthen the construction of professional ethics. Fully leverage the important role of judicial professional ethics construction in cultivating judicial conscience and shaping judge behavior, actively take effective measures, continuously strengthen deep feelings for the people, loyalty to the law, and faith and pursuit of fairness and justice. Strive to create a cultural atmosphere that advocates and abides by professional ethics, actively explore the establishment of an evaluation system for judicial professional ethics, adopt various forms such as admonition talks, warning education, and ethical evaluation to enhance the binding force of judicial professional ethics.

(2) Strictly regulate judicial behavior. Attach great importance to the institutionalization of judicial behavior, use clear institutional norms to constrain and guide the words and deeds of court personnel, strictly regulate the civilized language of the People's Courts, form a long-term mechanism of managing people by systems and handling affairs according to systems, and strive to shape standardized and civilized judicial behavior culture. Educate and guide court personnel to abide by judicial etiquette, standardize judicial words and deeds, pay attention to judicial civilization, improve judicial style, and establish a judicial image. Organize inspection activities to strengthen the supervision and assessment of court personnel's judicial behavior.

(3) Effectively safeguard judicial fairness. Further establish and improve case handling standards and norms for important positions such as case filing, criminal trials, civil and commercial trials, administrative trials, trial supervision, and enforcement, strictly regulate the exercise of authority and professional words and deeds of the majority of court personnel, ensure the realization of fairness and justice, and establish the image of judicial fairness. Educate and guide court personnel in handling cases to adhere to facts as the basis and law as the criterion, achieve substantive justice, procedural justice, and image justice, continuously improve the quality and efficiency of case handling, and strive to achieve the organic unity of legal effects, social effects, and political effects.

(4) Enhance the awareness of judicial integrity. In accordance with the requirements of "strictly governing the court," actively cultivate a culture of judicial integrity, strictly implement disciplinary provisions such as the "Five Prohibitions," effectively ensure that warning education and supervision management are in place, continuously improve the ability of the majority of court personnel to resist corruption and maintain integrity, enhance the awareness of anti-corruption and promoting integrity, and strive to form an ideological and moral foundation and cultural atmosphere where honesty is honored and corruption is disgraced.

(5) Implement measures for serving the people through justice. Continuously carry out the theme practice activity of "People's Judges for the People," enhance the theoretical recognition, emotional recognition, and practical recognition of the majority of court personnel regarding the people's nature of the People's Courts. Adhere to going deep into the masses for investigation and visits, conducting circuit trials, delivering law to the grassroots, implementing systems such as first inquiry responsibility, service commitments, and civilized reception, and put the requirements of serving the people through justice into practice.

(6) Focus on exemplary role models. In accordance with the central government's requirements, deeply carry out activities of striving for excellence, actively cultivate and vigorously commend advanced models within the court system, and strive to create a good atmosphere of learning from and catching up with advanced models. Extensively carry out activities to learn from major models such as Song Yushui and Chen Yanping, as well as advanced models around them, increase publicity efforts, play the leading and exemplary role of advanced models, and comprehensively enhance the professional cultivation and professional image of the court team.

4. Strive to Create a Distinctive Cultural Atmosphere that Advocates Learning and Positive Progress

Creating a distinctive cultural atmosphere that advocates learning and positive progress is an important task of the cultural development of People's Courts and an important guarantee for building a learning court. Closely combine the construction of a learning court with the cultural development of the People's Courts, making them mutually reinforcing and complementary, to provide a strong guarantee for improving the judicial capabilities of the majority of court personnel.

(1) Vigorously strengthen the construction of a learning court. Earnestly implement the spirit and requirements of the central government on building a learning society and a learning political party, and vigorously strengthen the construction of a learning court. Foster a strong atmosphere of learning in the court, guide the majority of court personnel to firmly establish the concept of learning for all and lifelong learning. Educate court personnel to improve their style of study, focus on doing their own work well and improving judicial capabilities, and truly apply what they have learned. Further establish and improve the learning system, and strive to form a long-term mechanism to strengthen learning.

(2) Extensively carry out the activity of "love reading, read good books, and be good at reading." Guide the majority of court personnel to regard reading as an important way to improve work ability, cultivate good reading habits, enrich knowledge reserves, optimize knowledge structure, and enhance cultural taste. Closely combine reading activities with the actual work of the court, establish reading interest groups, organize reading clubs, etc., to promote the in-depth development of reading activities.

(3) Effectively strengthen the construction of libraries (reading rooms). Regard the construction of libraries (reading rooms) as a basic task for building a learning court and improving team quality, and earnestly grasp it. Specifically set up "judge bookshelves," scientifically equip and timely update legal business and other types of books according to the actual needs of court work, providing good conditions for the work and learning of the majority of court personnel.

(4) Focus on the construction of court publications and networks. Actively establish court publications with distinctive features, providing an important platform for the majority of court personnel to summarize and exchange thoughts and experiences, work methods, and case handling insights. Set up a special column for court cultural construction on the court intranet, providing an effective carrier for the majority of court personnel to strengthen learning and participate in cultural construction. Courts with conditions shall strengthen cooperation with news media such as newspapers, radio, television, and the internet, set up special columns and special programs to publicize the work of the People's Courts, and actively spread and display court culture to society.

(5) Strengthen the construction of court history (honor) rooms. Use dedicated spaces to set up court history (honor) rooms, focusing on displaying the court's development history, work achievements, awards and honors received, and the outstanding deeds of advanced models. Organize court personnel, especially new recruits, to visit and study in the court history (honor) rooms, receive ideological education, and stimulate a sense of collective honor and belonging. Establish a "court open day," invite the people and people from all walks of life to visit the court history (honor) rooms, and deepen their understanding and support for court work.

(6) Strengthen the cultural image shaping of trial and office spaces. Plan and construct courtrooms and office spaces in accordance with the requirements of "appropriate scale, solemn and practical, standardized layout, and complete functions," striving to shape a material environment that reflects the culture of the People's Courts. Focus on strengthening the construction of civilized windows such as case filing and petition handling, earnestly implement various judicial measures to facilitate and benefit the people, and strive to create a good atmosphere of respect and convenience for the people. In accordance with the requirements of "strengthening the court through science and technology," reasonably configure office facilities, continuously improve the technological content of offices, gradually improve office conditions, actively promote electronic office, and create a convenient, relaxed, and harmonious working environment for the majority of court personnel.

(7) Strengthen the cultural atmosphere in public areas of the court. Utilize public areas such as the office building lobby, corridors, and reception rooms to carefully create a "cultural corridor" and "cultural wall," hanging and posting legal maxims, integrity aphorisms, textual signs reflecting the court's work philosophy, and various works created by the majority of court personnel that reflect the spirit of the times and the style of judges. Courts with conditions shall set up electronic scrolling screens (touch screens) to promptly display and publicize the cultural concepts and cultural practice activities of the People's Courts.

(8) Strengthen the construction of sports and cultural venues and facilities. Give full play to subjective initiative, actively raise funds, establish and improve sports and cultural activity venues, configure related equipment and facilities, and provide good conditions for the majority of court personnel to relieve work pressure, cultivate good living habits, and maintain physical and mental health. Organize and establish various sports associations, cultural groups, and interest groups, actively carry out various forms of fitness and sports activities and cultural activities, and continuously enrich the cultural life of the majority of court personnel.

(9) Pay attention to humanistic care and spiritual counseling. Establish and implement systems such as leading cadres contacting court personnel and daily exchanges of heart-to-heart talks to smooth communication channels with court personnel. While "strictly governing the court," adhere to "treating court personnel preferentially," satisfy the reasonable needs of court personnel as much as possible, and help them solve practical difficulties in work and life. Scientifically and reasonably set work indicators and assessment standards, implement national regulations on cadre vacations, regularly organize physical examinations for court personnel, carry out mental health education, alleviate physical and psychological pressure on court personnel, and cultivate a positive, optimistic, rational, peaceful, healthy, and upward mindset. Courts with conditions may hire professional psychologists to provide psychological adjustment for front-line judges, providing encouragement and pressure relief for court personnel from multiple aspects.

5. Effectively Strengthen the Organizational Leadership of the Cultural Development of People's Courts

(1) Attach great importance and strengthen leadership. People's Courts at all levels shall carry out court cultural construction in light of actual conditions, study and formulate specific plans and measures to strengthen court cultural construction. Establish a leading group for court cultural construction, with the main leader taking overall responsibility and the leader in charge handling specific matters, promptly study and solve problems related to work arrangements, personnel allocation, and funding guarantees for cultural construction. Incorporate cultural construction into the court management system as an important indicator for evaluating the overall work of the court to ensure the realization of cultural construction goals. Attach importance to institutional construction, effectively strengthen the standardized management of each work link, and ensure the healthy and orderly development of cultural construction.

(2) Clarify responsibilities and form synergy. The political departments of People's Courts at all levels shall play a leading and coordinating role, doing a good job in the planning, guidance, supervision, and inspection of cultural construction; other departments and Party-mass organizations shall actively implement the overall deployment and requirements of court cultural construction, fully play their functional roles, coordinate the development of related work, and ensure the formation of a good work pattern with clear responsibilities, division of labor, and joint management.

(3) Strengthen demonstration and guidance. Summarize and promote fresh experiences in court cultural construction from various regions and set examples. The Supreme People's Court will timely launch "National Court Cultural Construction Demonstration Units," and high people's courts at all levels shall strengthen court cultural demonstration construction within their jurisdictions, promoting from point to area and advancing the overall development of the cultural construction of People's Courts.

(4) Strengthen funding guarantees. Effectively increase investment in cultural construction, allocate special funds for carrying out cultural activities, building sports and cultural venues, etc., ensuring that the investment ratio gradually increases with economic growth.
